preconditions.description: Both P and T are strings.
The length of P is between 1 and 10^4.
The length of T is between 1 and 10^4.

postconditions.description: The output is within the range [0, 10^9 + 6].

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for start_positions in product_of_start_positions if product_of_start_positions % 2520 == 0) % (10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: The output is the number of ways to select one or more occurrences of P in T such that the product of their starting positions is divisible by 2520, modulo 10^9 + 7.
